review_text: I am giving this store 4 stars because, over the years, I have had many positive experiences here. The employees have generally been kind, helpful, and professional, and I have spent a significant amount of money at this location throughout the years.  However, I am withholding the fifth star because of what happened today.  I accidentally left my debit card at home and only had my EBT card with me. I also had reward points available that I intended to use toward prepared food while using my EBT card for my groceries. I explained this to the cashier, but I was told the transaction could not be separated that way.  Because I did not have my card with me, I agreed to let the points be applied to the total purchase and then use my EBT card for the remaining eligible items. After my points were used, I was informed that I still had a balance of about $14 that had to be paid out of pocket.  What made this especially frustrating was my situation. I had my two little daughters with me, I was running errands all day, and I simply wanted to grab some prepared food so they could eat while we were out. I genuinely did not have extra money available at that moment. My reward points were supposed to be what got me through the transaction.  What was even more disappointing was being told that the transaction could not be voided because EBT had already been used and that the funds could not be returned. That was surprising to me because in the past, at other stores, when an EBT transaction needed to be canceled, the funds were returned to my card. Whether that is a system limitation or not, it created a very difficult situation for me today.  To be clear, this is not a complaint about the manager or the employees. Everyone was polite, and I do not believe anyone was intentionally unhelpful. It seemed more like a system issue that nobody knew how to work around.  Still, as a customer who has spent thousands of dollars at this store over the years, today’s experience was genuinely painful and frustrating. Sitting there with my two children, trying to figure out how to feed them and finish my errands, only to be stuck with a balance I couldn’t comfortably pay, was not a good feeling.  Because of the many years of positive experiences I’ve had here, I am still giving 4 stars. But if I’m being honest, today’s experience left such a bad impression that I don’t see myself returning anytime soon, if ever. I may just take my business elsewhere in the future.  I hope this feedback helps improve the experience for customers who may find themselves in a similar situation.
owner_response:
Good evening, Ma, 
   Thank you for your feedback and for being a loyal customer over the years. We sincerely apologize for the frustration you experienced during your recent visit.
    We appreciate your kind words about our team and are glad our staff treated you with courtesy and professionalism. While certain EBT and payment processing limitations are system controlled, we understand how difficult and disappointing the situation was, especially while caring for your two daughters.
     Your feedback has been shared with management and will help us review our procedures to better assist customers in similar situations. To better support and ensure we investigate this better, please email us at wazobiamarket@gmail.com. 
    Thank you again for your years of support. We truly value your business and hope to have the opportunity to serve you again.
